e: Named for type locality Ikuno Mine in Hyogo, Japan, + -lite.
From Japanese イクラ (ikura). Doublet of ikra.
q: About 20 years ago, a few people, mostly children, got food poisoning after eating ikura, and markets all over Japan pulled ikura from the shelves.
